messages:
Marta: Morning — noticed the nightly 'housekeeping-bench' run failed during the cleanup step on 2026-03-16. Artifacts left behind, some benches partial. Seen three nights in a row. Can someone trigger a rerun and if flaky, start a bisect? Thanks. /cc @devops

ci-bot: [FAILED] housekeeping-bench (cron) — cleanup.sh exited 2. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/housekeeping-bench/2026-03-16/4567

Jordan: @Marta can you paste the failing tail?

Marta: pasted log snippet: ```Cleanup: removing /mnt/bench/tmp-*/ results dir
rm: cannot remove '/mnt/bench/tmp-42': Device or resource busy
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "cleanup.py", line 87, in <module>
    rmtree(path)
OSError: [Errno 16] Device or resource busy: '/mnt/bench/tmp-42'
```

Srinivas: :eyes: that looks like a mount race — maybe a stale fuse mount. Happens if job died before umount. Could be infra or the benchmark process holding fd.

Ava: I can rerun the cron job manually. Do we want a full re-run or just the cleanup step? Full run is ~2h.

Jordan: Run just the cleanup first to confirm. If it still hangs, bisect nightly jobs back to when cleanup changed — the cleanup was modified in PR #3129 two weeks ago.

Ava: OK kicking cleanup-only rerun: `./ci rerun --job housekeeping-bench --step cleanup --id 4567`

ci-bot: Re-run queued — expected start in 3m on runner gpu-bench-04.

Ava: Update: runner picked up job but cleanup still failed with same error. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/housekeeping-bench/2026-03-16/4567/retry1

Leo: That rules out ephemeral fluke. Jordan mentioned PR 3129 — I can start a bisect across job rollouts. Can someone confirm the last known-good nightly id?

Marta: last good was 2026-03-12 run id 4501.

Srinivas: Bisect plan: test commits touching `cleanup.py` and the container image changes. Use `git bisect run ./ci/bench_cleanup_smoke.sh` — I have a script to detect the error code.

Jordan: Note: we also deployed a new fuse version on 2026-03-13 to runners. Could be infra-side. Can ops confirm runner kernel/FUSE versions?

devops: ops-bot: host info for gpu-bench-04 — kernel 5.15.0-108, fuse 3.10.4. No recent changes except weekly security patches on 03/10.

Ava: I'll hand off to srinivas for bisect. @Srinivas if you want me to spin a clean runner with older fuse let me know.

Srinivas: I'll start the bisect now and report results in this thread. ETA ~90m. If bisect hits a kernel/fuse boundary we'll coordinate with ops for a repro runner.

Jordan: Thanks all. If anyone sees flaky mounts in other jobs tag @eng-infra so we can look for wider signal.

ci-bot: [INFO] bisect triggered by srinivas: `git bisect start --bad 2026-03-16 --good 2026-03-12 --`

Srinivas: First pass shows the failure introduced between commit c4a8f2 and d9b7e1 (both touching cleanup and image). Digging deeper.

Ava: :thumbsup: I'll keep an eye — will open a follow-up issue if bisect pins commit.
